$comment: Story 4.6 (ADR-158): GROUND ZERO — Priya's way; north under HIVR with the Pulse Gun. Ravi's state changes the last door; Deepa's reading of the log changes what you find.

panels.title: UNDER HEBBAL · 04:20
panels.text: North on foot with Priya. The tunnel ends in a service door with HIVR's logo scratched off.

panels.title: THE INNER DOOR
panels.text: Ravi is there with Meera's card. 'I'll open it. You close it.'

panels.title: THE INNER DOOR
panels.text: Meera's card opens it. Nobody holds it for you.

panels.title: THE INNER DOOR
panels.text: Ravi's ID gets you past the last checkpoint. The rest you force.

panels.title: THE SOURCE
panels.text: Tanks of grey culture under a dead purple light. Priya: 'Twenty charges.' You use four.

panels.title: THE SOURCE
panels.text: On the screen above the tanks, the AMR-07 log Deepa read: 14 March, 02:10. Someone left it open.

panels.title: HEBBAL · DAWN
panels.text: The city doesn't cheer. It just gets quiet.

panels.title: GROUND ZERO
panels.text: You ended it where it started.
